run_calc_gt_info: run the script to calculate visibility and 2D bounding boxes for ground-truth poses in a BOP dataset
create_renderer_for_depth: create a depth renderer with vispy, cpp, or python backend for rendering 3D object models
estimate_visibility_mask: estimate the visibility mask of an object in its ground-truth pose using distance image comparison
load_scene_camera_and_gt: load scene camera parameters and ground-truth pose data from a BOP dataset split
calc_2d_bbox_from_mask: calculate the 2D bounding box of an object silhouette from its pixel mask coordinates
